thread:
maria: FYI vendor CloudFrame just told us one pallet of H200s delayed, ETA +72h. Serial manifest missing 2 units. Need contingency for EU pools — can we avoid cluster starvation? :grimacing:
kevin: How many units affected? queue size? any AWB or proforma?
maria: They said 12 units delayed, 8 shipped now, 4 pending RMA/DOA hold. AWB 123-ABCD will arrive but customs flagged a missing HS code. Shipping note says 'partial replace'.
frances: From procurement side — vendor offers 3% credit for delay but wants us to split courier fee. Also asks if we accept partial replacements or prefer full manifest hold.
alex: If 4 units are held, EU dedicated pool loses ~20% capacity next week. We can route traffic to us-west spares with smart-routing but EU latency rises. Recommend temporary route + automatic fallback policy.
maria: @alex what's ETA to enable routing? Also need to check data residency for Private deployments.
alex: ~2 hours to add route and enable fallback for hosted. For Private customers we need signed ok from security — ping @islab.
islab: Security ok for encrypted KV traffic across regions for hosted, but Private deployments require explicit customer consent. I have a template, send affected customer list.
maria: Sending list now. Also vendor proposes RMA for 2 DOA units and asks to reassign serials to loaners. Thoughts?
kevin: Approve loaners for self-serve/non-enterprise customers. For SLA/enterprise customers: escalate — no serial swaps without signed acceptance. I'll draft a message to vendor.
logistics-bot: AWB update — 123-ABCD scanned in FRA. Customs hold flagged: missing HS code on two units.
maria: Can ops confirm HS code? I think vendor used 8542.31.
frances: Vendor included HS 8542.31 in email. I'll forward docs to our customs broker and request consolidated invoice.
kevin: Also request consolidated AWB for the shipment to speed customs clearance, and include serials on invoice.
maria: @frances can you ask vendor for consolidated AWB + shipper invoice listing serials and insurance value? That should reduce holdbacks.
frances: On it. I'm also negotiating waiver on expedite fee — vendor offered 50% off.
alex: Ops note — past delays caused KV cache churn and +30% CPU on runtime. We should pre-warm critical KV prefixes before routing change.
maria: Good call. @ops-team can you schedule prefix pre-warm for EU critical flows and ramp throttles to avoid spikes?
ops-team: Will run prewarm script and throttle. ETA 45m to start, 2h to verify telemetry.
maria: Deployment plan: kevin -> SLA customers handling; frances -> AWB/credit negotiation; alex -> enable fallback routing and pre-warm; islab -> get privacy signoffs for Private tenants. I'll coordinate vendor comms and update customers. :raised_hands:
kevin: Sent legal a note re: enterprise serials. Draft snippet: ```We cannot reassign customer-owned serials for enterprise customers without signed acceptance; loaner swaps are allowed for non-enterprise only.```
frances: Vendor replied — they can do consolidated AWB if we accept a 2-week window for remaining 4 units. They add 1.5% extra credit if we consolidate.
maria: I'm leaning: accept consolidation for non-critical fleets, expedite replacements for SLA customers (we absorb up to the 50% waived courier cost).
kevin: Agreed. I'll lock that with vendor and flag exceptions.
logistics-bot: RMA ticket RMA-8942 opened; vendor pickup scheduled ETA 48h for the two DOA units.
maria: Thanks — I'll post an incident-lite update to #eng-runtime and ping affected customers.
